definition: to start living in a new place
description: A wooden treehouse in a rainforest during a rain shower. A young woman in a tank top, shorts and hiking boots stands on the small porch by the open door and pulls up a net bundle on a rope holding a cardboard box, a rolled sleeping mat, a potted plant and a bag, then lifts it onto the porch and turns towards the door. A monkey sits on the corrugated metal roof next to a lantern. A man on a platform below holds the other end of the rope, and huge tropical leaves surround the cabin.

taps.phrase: to steady the rope from below
